notes_for_editor: Fact-check 2026-10-21: story said 'beside' U.S. 82 where the datasheet says 'along'; fixed. Elevation: the list gives no unit, and the datasheet's orthometric height (132.94 ft / 40.521 m) now backs the story's 133 ft figure. The tower was dismantled before 1978 (NGS datasheet BS0174 recovery note). The record's status 'unknown' is set to gone under facts, not filed as a correction. The list's coordinates are the marker's own scaled position, so the tower location is approximate, roughly 185 m north to south. The datasheet says 'Forest Service' without naming which one, so no agency is set. Build date, height and staffing are not in any source found. The NGS page says photos may exist for this station; not checked. The 1978 note measures from the U.S. 1 and 23 junction in downtown Waycross (4.65 miles), the 1961 note from the railroad station (4.9 miles). No source describes the site today.
